data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'petra' meaning 'rock'. In Christian tradition, Petr is the name of Saint Peter, the first pope and one of the twelve apostles. The name Petr carries the meaning “Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Petr usually hope their child will grow to embody rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petr total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Petr, with its roots in Latin, links the bearer to the rich history and cultural influence of Rome and the Roman Catholic Church. With the name Petr, comes the legacy of Saint Peter, a symbol of leadership and the foundation of the Church.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Petr holds deep spiritual significance as it is the name of Saint Peter, one of the twelve apostles and the first pope. biblical_reference.note: In the New Testament, the name Peter (Greek: Πέτρος, Petros) is given to the apostle Simon Bar-Jonah, who was a fisherman by trade before Jesus called him to be a disciple. Peter was a key figure among the apostles and is traditionally considered to be the first Bishop of Rome and the founder of the Roman Catholic Church.
